info.description: Drexa is a file storage and management API. It provides endpoints for authentication, user management, file uploads, and virtual filesystem operations.
info.title: Drexa API

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Returns the account, user, and authentication tokens.

get.description: Retrieve account details including storage usage and quota

post.description: Create a new directory within a parent directory

400.description: Parent not found or not a directory

delete.description: Delete multiple directories permanently or move them to trash. Deleting directories also affects all their contents. All items must be directories.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of directory IDs to delete
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Move to trash instead of permanent delete
parameters.name: trash

get.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific directory

delete.description: Delete a directory permanently or move it to trash. Deleting a directory also affects all its contents.

parameters.description: Move to trash instead of permanent delete
parameters.name: trash

patch.description: Update directory properties such as name (rename)

get.description: Get all files and subdirectories within a directory

200.description: Array of FileInfo and DirectoryInfo objects

post.description: Move one or more files or directories into this directory. Returns detailed status for each item including which were successfully moved, which had conflicts, and which encountered errors.

200.description: Move operation results with moved, conflict, and error states

400.description: Invalid request or items not in same directory

404.description: One or more items not found

delete.description: Delete multiple files permanently or move them to trash. All items must be files.

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of file IDs to delete
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Move to trash instead of permanent delete
parameters.name: trash

get.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific file

delete.description: Delete a file permanently or move it to trash

parameters.description: Move to trash instead of permanent delete
parameters.name: trash

patch.description: Update file properties such as name (rename)

get.description: Download the file content. May redirect to a signed URL for external storage.

post.description: Start a new file upload session. Returns an upload URL to PUT file content to.

409.description: File with this name already exists

patch.description: Mark an upload as completed after content has been uploaded. This finalizes the file in the filesystem.

400.description: Content not uploaded yet or invalid status

put.description: Stream file content to complete an upload. Send raw binary data in the request body.

post.description: Authenticate with email and password to receive JWT tokens. Tokens can be delivered via HTTP-only cookies or in the response body based on the tokenDelivery field.

400.description: Invalid request body or token delivery method

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new pair of access and refresh tokens. The old refresh token is invalidated (rotation).

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

get.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information

internal_account.Account.description: Storage account with usage and quota details

updatedAt.description: When the account was last updated (ISO 8601)

userId.description: ID of the user who owns this account

internal_account.registerAccountRequest.description: Request to create a new account and user

email.description: Email address for the new account

password.description: Password for the new account (min 8 characters)

accessToken.description: JWT access token for immediate authentication

internal_auth.loginRequest.description: Login request with email, password, and token delivery preference

tokenDelivery.description: How to deliver tokens: "cookie" (set HTTP-only cookies) or "body" (include in response)

internal_auth.loginResponse.description: Login response containing user info and optionally tokens

accessToken.description: JWT access token (only included when tokenDelivery is "body")

refreshToken.description: Base64 URL encoded refresh token (only included when tokenDelivery is "body")

internal_auth.refreshAccessTokenRequest.description: Request to exchange a refresh token for new tokens

internal_auth.tokenResponse.description: Response containing new access token and refresh token

refreshToken.description: New base64 URL encoded refresh token

internal_catalog.DirectoryInfo.description: Directory information including path and timestamps

deletedAt.description: When the directory was trashed, null if not trashed (ISO 8601)

updatedAt.description: When the directory was last updated (ISO 8601)

internal_catalog.FileInfo.description: File information including name, size, and timestamps

deletedAt.description: When the file was trashed, null if not trashed (ISO 8601)

updatedAt.description: When the file was last updated (ISO 8601)

internal_catalog.createDirectoryRequest.description: Request to create a new directory

internal_catalog.moveItemError.description: Error details for a failed item move

error.description: Error message describing what went wrong

id.description: ID of the item that failed to move

internal_catalog.moveItemsToDirectoryRes.description: Response from moving items to a directory with status for each item

conflicts.description: Array of IDs of items that conflicted with existing items in the target directory

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred during the move operation

items.description: Array of items included in the request (FileInfo or DirectoryInfo objects)

moved.description: Array of IDs of successfully moved items

internal_catalog.postDirectoryContentReq.description: Request to move items into this directory

items.description: Array of file/directory IDs to move

internal_upload.Upload.description: File upload session with status and upload URL

uploadUrl.description: URL to upload file content to

internal_upload.createUploadRequest.description: Request to initiate a file upload

name.description: Name of the file being uploaded

parentId.description: ID of the parent directory to upload into

internal_upload.updateUploadRequest.description: Request to update upload status (e.g., mark as completed)
